record_format: foresight-evidence-spine contract v2 (docs/ops/FORESIGHT-EVIDENCE-SPINE.md) + hindsight retain payload (docs/ops/sessions/HINDSIGHT.md)
rules: Documented limits are policy ceilings, not proof of account entitlement or balances. Never invent remaining capacity.

planned_use: spend up to safety x limit, paced linearly over the window; routing multiplier = remaining-budget fraction / remaining-time fraction, capped at 2, 0 when exhausted, 1.0 when no live reading.
Private records stay outside Git and public artifacts; only explicit status-only projections may be published.
